title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, update docs site and examples
author: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Adds opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, new tool-calling quickstarts in Python and TypeScript, and docsite navigation + example links. Motivation: Make it easier for engineers to adopt agents with tool-calling and RAG patterns by providing vetted templates, copy-paste quickstarts, and a docs landing page that highlights common patterns and safety notes. Changes include: new docs pages under docs/rag, three example quickstarts (py/ts/playground), updated site sidebar and examples index. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates (agent prompt + configuration) - [x] Add Python & TS tool-calling quickstarts - [x] Wire examples into docs site and sidebars - [x] Add unit/e2e smoke tests for examples - [x] Link Linear/DOCS tickets and changelog Context: This PR consolidates several community requests (Linear ENG-4821) and follows the RAG templates we piloted with the Solutions team. It also addresses a small UX gap on the docs site where agent examples were hard to find. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; examples target public SDKs. Deploy notes: Docs site needs a docs-build after merge to pick up sidebars and example assets. See linked examples in /examples/agents and the quickstart scripts that are intended to be runnable locally and in CI.
commits: feat(docs): add rag agent templates and config examples
fix(docs): update sidebar and crosslinks, fix broken example path
